edit.description: Widen hermeticEnv pin (~L646-678) to assert no FLUME_-prefixed var survives (or extend to all 5), per derived-state section — stale since FLUME_DIR_RESOLVED_FOR/FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD were added to hermeticEnv without extending this test.

summary: hermeticEnv() strips 5 FLUME_* vars; its only regression pin covers a stale 3-of-5 subset (2 additions since, unpinned)

per.section: Derived state is computed, never restated beside its source

tests: hermeticEnv() leaves no FLUME_-prefixed key in its returned env, covering FLUME_DIR_RESOLVED_FOR and FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD alongside FLUME_DIR/FLUME_CONFIG_DIR/FLUME_JOB
acceptance: cli.test.ts's hermeticEnv pin fails if hermeticEnv() regresses on any FLUME_* var it strips, not just the original three
notes: Prefer asserting no /^FLUME_/-prefixed key survives (derives from hermeticEnv's own behavior) over hardcoding a 5-element list, which just recreates the same staleness risk at larger N. Docstring at cli.test.ts:646-652 says 'all three canonical' — update if kept as prose.
